cat > hera_scratch/ana_spots_promote.py <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, plot_raw, sdh_onset, sdh_fft
for rid,n in [(6,3.2),(7,-1.2)]:
    r=open_run(Path('data')/str(rid))
    plot_raw(r); plt.show()
    B=r.col('magnet_field'); R=r.col('sr1_X')/(r.col('sr0_X')/-1e6)
    on=sdh_onset(R,B,r_full_scale=5000)
    print(f'Run {rid}, n={n}e12, D=0; '+on.summary())
    fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4))
    for lo in [1.,2.,3.]:
        f,a=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(lo,10.),log=False,nfft=2048)
        ax[0].plot(f,a[0]/a[0].max(),label=f'B >= {lo:g} T')
    ax[0].set(xlim=(0,60),xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='normalized FFT');ax[0].legend()
    for t in on.tones: ax[1].semilogy(t.b_centers,t.snr,label=f'{t.freq:.1f} T')
    ax[1].axhline(5,color='k',ls=':');ax[1].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='matched-filter SNR');ax[1].legend(fontsize=7)
    plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('Read: sr1 / B_1-B_2 remains unclassified. Candidate electron tones near 7, 22, 29 T include a harmonic/sum-tone ambiguity; no pocket count assigned. Default onset for run 6 is censored at 0.3 T, where the 50 mT sampling fails Nyquist. Run 7 onset ~0.71 T is close to its 20 mT sampling floor, and the allowed hole density is in the close-pair model regime. Acquire an electron low-field extension before designing the fan; retain raw signed R (negative portions exist), not log-clipped R. No B-reversal symmetrization is available. Calibration and possible secondary CNP remain systematic uncertainties.')

from hera.analysis import field_invB
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages
# Read-only preflight: committed safety surfaces must still equal the card.
for p,bounds in [(k_tg.volt,(-.3,1.)),(k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.)),(dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.,25.)),(dc205.voltage,(-25.,25.)),(magnet.field,(-10.,10.)),(heater.sample_setpoint,(0.,100.)),(heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.,100.))]:
    actual=(p.vals._min_value,p.vals._max_value)
    print(p.full_name,'validator expected',bounds,'actual',actual); assert actual == bounds
assert B_SESSION_CAP == 10 and T_SESSION_CAP == 100
assert_thermometry_live('T_sample',VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_sample'],max_age=15,max_period=12)
assert_thermometry_live('T_vaporizer',VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_vaporizer'],max_age=15,max_period=12)
Ts,Tv,B0,Si=T_sample(),T_vaporizer(),magnet.field(),k_si()
print('Expected base T=1-1.5 K, vaporizer<1.6, B~0, Si=0; actual',Ts,Tv,B0,Si)
assert 1<=Ts<=1.5 and Tv<1.6 and abs(Ts-Tv)<.6 and abs(B0)<.02 and abs(Si)<.01
print('Heater ranges expected 0/0:',heater.sample_range(),heater.vaporizer_range())
assert heater.sample_range()==0 and heater.vaporizer_range()==0
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert dc205.voltage_range()==2 and dc205.output()==1 and dc205.ramp_rate==.5
for li in [sr0,sr1]:
    print(li.name,'tau/slope expected .3/24, actual',li.time_constant(),li.filter_slope())
    assert li.time_constant()==.3 and li.filter_slope()==24
print('Drive expected 1 V,13.777 Hz:',sr1.amplitude(),sr1.frequency())
assert abs(sr1.amplitude()-1)<1e-6 and abs(sr1.frequency()-13.777)<.01
assert k_tg.volt.step==.005 and k_bg.volt.step==.005
assert k_tg.nplci()==1 and k_bg.nplci()==1
assert WIRING['sr1+']=='B_1' and WIRING['sr1-']=='B_2'
CAL=dict(c_tg=2.796e-3,c_bg=2.161e-3,n_offset=-.0894,D_offset=-.013)
vt,vb=calc_gate_voltages(3.2,0,**CAL)
k_tg.volt.validate(vt);k_bg.volt.validate(vb)
B_vec=field_invB(.3,2.5,295)
for b in B_vec: magnet.field.validate(b)
sr1.sensitivity(20e-6)  # 2 kohm FS; run 6 below 2.5 T is <65 ohm
mc=dict(meas_config);mc.update({'Si (V)':Si,'sample_temperature:':Ts,'comments':'electron onset extension n=3.2e12 D=0, B .3->2.5 T, uniform 1/B 295 points, 3 s dwell; run-5 calibration'})
s=sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment('onset extension and grid-change: n=+3.2e12 cm^-2 D=0; B .3->2.5 T 295 uniform-1/B points; 20 uV sr1; tau=.3 s slope=24 dwell=3 s; Si=0; cal run5')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,vb);s.ramp(k_tg.volt,vt)
interruptible_sleep(3)
s.fp(T_sample).fp(T_vaporizer).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr).fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
for p in [T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P]: s.plot(magnet.field,p)
def extension_guard(station,data):
    # time,B,Ts,Tv,Itg,Ibg,sr0X,sr0P,sr1X,sr1P
    if not (1<=data[2]<=1.5 and data[3]<1.6 and abs(data[4])<1e-9 and abs(data[5])<1e-9 and abs(data[8])<.9*20e-6):
        print('STOP: extension temperature/leakage/range guard',data);station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_after(extension_guard,())
s.sweep(magnet.field,B_vec,delay=3.)
print('Extension end actual B,TG,BG:',magnet.field(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt())

cat > hera_scratch/md_onset_extension.md <<'MD'
## HERA — resolve the censored electron onset before the stacking fan
Runs 6–7 are analyzed in ana. Run 6 gives candidate tones near 7/22/29 T, but `sdh_onset` returns a censored 0.30 T edge and the 50 mT low-field leg aliases the expected F_L=33.1 T. Per `landau-fan` step 1 and `sdh-spot-check` Verify, repeat the low-field segment with uniform 1/B sampling before spending hours on an onset-dependent fan grid. This is in-arc and retains the same n=+3.2e12, D=0 gate pair; only the electron side reaches the model's separated-template density regime.

Preconditions verify the handoff's base-T, heaters-off, zero-field and Si=0 state, original lock-in filters, gate pacing, and card-matched validators. Delta(1/B)=0.00998/T gives 3.03 samples/period at F_L and 2.52 at a +20% scale allowance. The 3 s dwell preserves 10 tau, with the magnet's own settle additional; sr1 20 uV gives 2 kohm full scale versus <65 ohm in this segment of run 6. All followed channels are plotted, with 1 nA leakage and temperature/range stop guards.

Pricing: 0→2.5 T costs 18.25 min at 1/7.3 T/min; 295 points × (3 s dwell + ~3.1 s field-settle/read overhead, run 6's 7.46 s at 10 mT minus 4.38 s ramp) adds 30 min, so budget 55 min including margin. Inspect first three rows, then every 10 min for leakage, clipping, temperature and current; interrupt on failure. VTI caveat: kernel interrupt does not halt an in-progress magnet ramp; re-read actual field before the next move. End at 2.5 T for the fan direction decision, gates held at the spot.
MD
